_evidence: 0x00521eb0 clears 0x66d8e9/0x66d840 and runs 0x521b93: 'mov eax,[0x66d8e0]; mov edx,[0x66d8dc]' (the grid cursor column/row, run-time state written by 0x521cb2/0x521cc7/0x521d8d/...), then by car flag byte +0x6f (the spec's esi record) inc/dec one of them unless the auto-repeat latch 'cmp byte [0x66d8e5],0xff; je' (set to 0xff at 0x521c88, cleared at 0x521bbb/0x521c0b) is set, and 0x521b37 clamps both to the static grid descriptor ([ebx+1] columns: 'cmp eax,ebp; jle / cmp eax,0; jge', row limits from its byte tables: 'cmp edx,ecx; jge/jle'), so any i32 cursor is valid and stays an in-bounds index; 'cmp eax,[0x66d8e0]; je' then compares with the old column. Cursors drawn around the grid (-1..9) plus the signed extremes; the latch 0xff in half the cases. The descriptor tables 0x893eb0/0x894054/0x89406c, the descriptors they point to (0x8940xx..0x8942xx) and the repeat delays 0x893ce0/0x893ce4 have no writer in the code (initialised .data), so they are constant and keep their image values.
